mentions.description: A suite of apps for photography spanning camera apps, editors, and utilities. The tools are designed to be lightweight and composable, with clean interfaces that respect user agency and privacy, provide technical clarity, and help users become better photographers by encouraging mastery of their tools and offering new approaches to picture making. The project draws inspiration from photography's history and pre-digital processes; currently available on Apple platforms only, with plans to expand to other platforms.
